posts.title: Yakuza: Like a Dragon Review – Heartfelt RPG Experience
posts.description: Yakuza: Like a Dragon captivates with its blend of humor and heartfelt redemption. Follow Ichiban Kasuga's journey of self-discovery, overcoming betrayal, and fighting for justice. Experience turn-based RPG mechanics and vibrant character roles.
